intent: A command-line tool that hashes and checks passwords: `pw hash <password>` prints a bcrypt hash, and `pw check <password> <hash>` exits 0 on a match and 1 otherwise. Owner's words: «una herramienta de línea de comandos que haga hash y verifique contraseñas con bcrypt».
check: the tasks: whether the swarm can build them in parallel units, with sound contracts and tests
